name: PT Bangun Karya Perkasa Jaya Tbk
summary: Operating within Indonesia, PT Bangun Karya Perkasa Jaya Tbk is a construction enterprise primarily engaged in steel manufacturing and general contracting services. The company's extensive project scope covers commercial properties, vital infrastructure such as roads, bridges, ports, and harbors, residential developments, and industrial facilities like factories and warehouses. Established in 2007, its corporate headquarters are located in Surabaya, Indonesia. PT Bangun Karya Perkasa Jaya Tbk functions as a subsidiary of PT Bangun Karya Artha Lestari.
